paragraphs.text: Omnipotent agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: Standard/PTC/Minimal + routing modes
An "omnipotent" agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that combines Standard / PTC / Minimal-style capab
ilities with routing modes (`spec` / `mixed` / `weak` / `react`) and Cordis creation mode.
Copy this directory to your Harness home:
Then select the `omnipotent` preset in DSH Web UI or via `/preset omnipotent`.
- No API keys or credentials are stored in this repository.
